title: E0118: Log forging via user input
plain_english: Writing unsanitized user input to logs can allow log forging, where an attacker injects fake log entries or corrupts log structure.
why_matters: Log forging can: - Hide malicious activity by injecting misleading log entries - Create false audit trail records - Corrupt log files and make incident response harder - Mislead anyone investigating system behavior
bad_example:
error_log("User {$_GET['username']} logged in");
// ?username=admin%0d%0aInjection: fake admin login
what_it_checks: Custom log writers such as `file_put_contents($log, $user_input)` with user input
